title: Add HQ IA to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [HQ IA](https://editoraitacaiunas.com.br/app/quadrinhos-ia) to image
- Create comic strips quickly with HQ IA, an AI-powered comic book creator.

Fixes #11729

gist.headline: Panels in the flowerbed
gist.blurb: HQ IA joined the image garden. It helps turn a prompt into comic strips without making you manually negotiate with every speech bubble.
gist.summary: Added HQ IA to the Pollinations image app catalog, giving creators an AI-powered tool for quickly making comic strips.
gist.impact: Users can now discover HQ IA through Pollinations and turn story ideas into comic-style panels faster.
gist.visual_concept: Depict HQ IA as a cozy comic-making desk: a sequence of blank-to-finished pixel comic panels, speech bubbles, and a little storyboard growing like a code-plant. Polli, wearing a tiny artist beret and holding a pencil, helps arrange the panels while the Monitor Robot eagerly displays the finished strip.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art comic studio where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee with pink blush, light blue wings, black antennae, and a tiny painter's beret, arranges a blooming storyboard of comic panels beside a friendly CRT Monitor Robot displaying a finished strip; flowers and code-plants surround the desk, with lime green (#ecf874) prominent in the panels and monitor glow. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with simple pixel-font text: "HQ IA".
